data_fields.name: evenShareLevel
data_fields.donor_constant: fellowship_even_share_level default 50 (all members >= this share evenly)

data_fields.name: evenShareLevelGap
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 levels: even share when max leader-member gap <= 5

data_fields.name: sizeShareTable
data_fields.donor_constant: 1.0, .75, .6, .55, .5, .45, .4, .35, .3 for 1-9 members (read; receipts on function header and TODO line)

data_fields.name: zeroShareRadius
data_fields.donor_constant: 2 x MaxDistance = 1200 (zero share at or beyond; linear between)

best_idea: A party's kill XP is a size-indexed share, scaled per member by distance, and the mode is picked from the level gap, so the rule can be a few zone-data numbers and one server function.
decision_why: Take the share-by-size table (capped at MAX_ATTACKERS = 3), the distance falloff and the level-gap band as one server function; drop the indoor/landblock rules and the 9-member table, and keep the group total explicit in the ledger (the table makes the group total exceed the kill XP).
acceptance: Server test: 3-member party, two members within 600 units and one at 900 units, all within 10 levels of the leader: a 1000 XP kill grants 600, 600 and 300 (total 1500), the ledger records each grant with its reason, and a member beyond 1200 units gets 0.
